top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Miners push stocks lower; Nvidia smashes earnings targets
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to City AM‘s FTSE 100 live blog. It’s Wednesday morning and the FTSE 100 is falling lower, as miners like Antofagasta, Endeavour and Fresnillo weigh on the index. Oil prices are falling following signs that global supplies are strengthening, despite the US and Iran’s latest exchange of fire in the Middle East. Stocks [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
top_signals.summary: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Southeast Asia’s data center boom leaned on Chinese demand. New U.S. rules put that pipeline at risk
top_signals.summary: The rules require data centers in Southeast Asia to seek U.S. approval to buy advanced AI chips, threatening to slow a build-out fueled heavily on Chinese demand.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
